authoredNote: Names and lines transcribed from a measured run and checked against the fixture source. Note the PINNED scope of `also_good` — see the rationale; that is the grammar's recovery, recorded so it cannot drift silently.
rationale: The negative half of the battery. Two separate contracts meet here. (1) Syntax errors are owned by ASTEngine (tree-sitter ERROR/MISSING nodes) and are NOT re-emitted by the analyzer — the analyzer declares no errors of its own. (2) The SWALLOW CLASS (#907): a definition absorbed into a damaged enclosing region must still be emitted. `resource "aws_s3_bucket" "also_good"` on line 13 follows a block whose `bucket =` value is missing, and tree-sitter welds it INSIDE `aws_s3_bucket.broken` — so its owner is the damaged block, not the document. That is the grammar's recovery shape, not an analyzer choice, and it is pinned here deliberately: the symbol is emitted (no swallow) and its reference `var.still_reachable` is published, while the containment path records the damage faithfully. The corpus-wide measurement of the genuinely-unrecoverable class is 2 files in 9,079 (`boundary/enos/modules/docker_worker/worker-config-bsr-downstream.hcl` and `nomad/command/agent/testdata/sample1/sample2.hcl`), where a Go-template `{{…}}` expression makes the grammar emit no `block` node at all and the loss is proved by minimal reconstruction in bb_tests/hcl/out/open-questions.txt.

forbidRelationships.note: pre-fix shape: `hclValueKind` reported the outermost expression node, so a comparison read as "operation" — a node type that names no value kind. The fix unwraps it to binary_operation/unary_operation.
